# kinu (Preact UI) Component Library Documentation

kinu is a lightweight, modern UI component library built for Preact that provides a comprehensive set of accessible, customizable components with minimal JavaScript and a CSS-based styling system.

## Architecture Overview

kinu is primarily a pass-through from JSX to semantic HTML that attaches `[k="component-name"]` attributes to elements for styling and behavior. The `k` attribute contains the kinu component name. CSS uses these attributes to style components without JavaScript, and delegated event handlers use them for features like keyboard navigation.

### Core Philosophy
- **Minimal JavaScript**: Components use native HTML elements with minimal JavaScript for enhanced functionality
- **CSS-based Styling**: All styling handled through CSS using `k` attribute selectors
- **Semantic HTML**: Components render as appropriate semantic HTML elements
- **Accessibility First**: Built with accessibility and keyboard navigation in mind

## Component Categories & Interfaces

### Form Controls

#### Button
Renders as: `<button>` or `<a>` (when href provided)
```tsx
<Button>Default</Button>
<Button variant="secondary">Secondary</Button>
<Button variant="outline">Outline</Button>
<Button variant="destructive">Destructive</Button>
<Button variant="ghost">Ghost</Button>
<Button variant="link">Link</Button>
<Button size="sm|md|lg|icon">Sized</Button>
<Button href="/path">Link Button</Button>
```

#### Input
Renders as: `<input>`
```tsx
<Input placeholder="Enter text" />
<Input type="email" value={email} onInput={handler} />
<Input size="sm|lg" />
<Input disabled />
```

#### Checkbox
Renders as: `<input type="checkbox">`
```tsx
<Checkbox id="check" checked={checked} onInput={handler} />
<Label htmlFor="check">Label text</Label>
```

#### Radio & RadioGroup
Renders as: `<div>` (RadioGroup), `<input type="radio">` (Radio)
```tsx
<RadioGroup>
  <Radio id="opt1" name="options" value="1" checked={selected === '1'} onInput={handler} />
  <Label htmlFor="opt1">Option 1</Label>
  <Radio id="opt2" name="options" value="2" checked={selected === '2'} onInput={handler} />
  <Label htmlFor="opt2">Option 2</Label>
</RadioGroup>
```

#### Select
Renders as: `<select>`
```tsx
<Select value={value} onInput={handler}>
  <option value="1">Option 1</option>
  <option value="2">Option 2</option>
</Select>
<Select disabled>
  <option>Disabled</option>
</Select>
```

#### Switch
Renders as: `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`
```tsx
<Switch checked={enabled} onInput={handler} />
```

#### Slider
Renders as: `<input type="range">`
```tsx
<Slider min={0} max={100} value={value} onInput={handler} />
<Slider disabled />
```

#### Textarea
Renders as: `<textarea>`
```tsx
<Textarea placeholder="Enter message..." value={message} onInput={handler} />
<Textarea disabled />
```

#### Label
Renders as: `<label>`
```tsx
<Label htmlFor="input-id">Label Text</Label>
```

### Layout Components

#### Card
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<Card>
  <h2>Card Title</h2>
  <p>Card content</p>
</Card>
```

#### Separator
Renders as: `<hr>`
```tsx
<div>
  <p>Content above</p>
  <Separator />
  <p>Content below</p>
</div>
```

#### AspectRatio
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<AspectRatio ratio={16/9}>
  <span>16:9 content</span>
</AspectRatio>
```

#### ScrollArea
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<ScrollArea style={{height: '100px'}}>
  <p>Scrollable content</p>
  <p>More content...</p>
</ScrollArea>
```

### Navigation Components

#### Tabs
Renders as: `<div>` (TabList), `<button>` (Tab), `<div>` (TabPanel)
```tsx
<TabList>
  <Tab aria-selected={tab === 'first'} onClick={() => setTab('first')}>First</Tab>
  <Tab aria-selected={tab === 'second'} onClick={() => setTab('second')}>Second</Tab>
</TabList>
{tab === 'first' && <TabPanel>First tab content</TabPanel>}
{tab === 'second' && <TabPanel>Second tab content</TabPanel>}
```

#### Breadcrumb
Renders as: `<nav>` (Breadcrumb), `<ol>` (BreadcrumbList), `<li>` (BreadcrumbItem), `<a>` (BreadcrumbLink)
```tsx
<Breadcrumb>
  <BreadcrumbList>
    <BreadcrumbItem>
      <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Home</BreadcrumbLink>
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem>
      <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Docs</BreadcrumbLink>
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem>Current</BreadcrumbItem>
  </BreadcrumbList>
</Breadcrumb>
```

#### NavigationMenu
Renders as: `<nav>` (NavigationMenu), `<ul>` (NavigationMenuList), `<li>` (NavigationMenuItem), `<a>` (NavigationMenuLink)
```tsx
<NavigationMenu>
  <NavigationMenuList>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuLink href="#">Home</NavigationMenuLink>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuLink href="#">Docs</NavigationMenuLink>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
  </NavigationMenuList>
</NavigationMenu>
```

#### Pagination
Renders as: `<nav>` (Pagination), `<ul>` (PaginationList), `<li>` (PaginationItem), `<a>` (PaginationLink)
```tsx
<Pagination>
  <PaginationList>
    <PaginationItem>
      <PaginationLink aria-current="page">1</PaginationLink>
    </PaginationItem>
    <PaginationItem>
      <PaginationLink>2</PaginationLink>
    </PaginationItem>
  </PaginationList>
</Pagination>
```

#### Menubar
Renders as: `<div>` (Menubar), `<button>` (MenubarItem)
```tsx
<Menubar>
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <MenubarItem>File</MenubarItem>
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuContent>
      <DropdownMenuItem onClick={handler}>Open</DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuItem onClick={handler}>Save</DropdownMenuItem>
    </DropdownMenuContent>
  </DropdownMenu>
</Menubar>
```

### Overlay Components

#### Dialog
Renders as: `<dialog>` (Dialog.Content)
```tsx
<Dialog id="unique-id">  // Optional ID
  <Dialog.Trigger>
    <Button>Open Dialog</Button>
  </Dialog.Trigger>
  <Dialog.Content>
    <h3>Dialog Title</h3>
    <p>Dialog content</p>
    <Dialog.Close>
      <Button>Close</Button>
    </Dialog.Close>
  </Dialog.Content>
</Dialog>
```

#### AlertDialog
Renders as: `<dialog>` (AlertDialog.Content)
```tsx
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialog.Trigger>
    <Button>Open Alert</Button>
  </AlertDialog.Trigger>
  <AlertDialog.Content>
    <p>Are you sure?</p>
    <AlertDialog.Close>
      <Button>Cancel</Button>
    </AlertDialog.Close>
    <AlertDialog.Close>
      <Button>Confirm</Button>
    </AlertDialog.Close>
  </AlertDialog.Content>
</AlertDialog>
```

#### DropdownMenu
Renders as: `<span>` (DropdownMenu), `<dialog>` (DropdownMenuContent), `<button>` (DropdownMenuItem)
```tsx
<DropdownMenu id="unique-id">  // Optional ID
  <DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <Button>Actions ▼</Button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuItem onClick={handler}>Edit</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem onClick={handler}>Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

#### ContextMenu
Renders as: `<dialog>` (ContextMenuContent), `<button>` (ContextMenuItem)
```tsx
<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger>
    <div>Right-click me</div>
  </ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent>
    <ContextMenuItem onClick={handler}>Cut</ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem onClick={handler}>Copy</ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

#### Popover
Renders as: `<dialog>` (PopoverContent)
```tsx
<Popover>
  <PopoverTrigger>
    <Button>Open Popover</Button>
  </PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent>
    <div>Popover content</div>
  </PopoverContent>
</Popover>
```

#### HoverCard
Renders as: `<dialog>` (HoverCardContent)
```tsx
<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger>
    <Button>Hover me</Button>
  </HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent>Hover content</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>
```

#### Tooltip
Renders as: `<span>`
```tsx
<Tooltip title="Tooltip text">
  <Button>Hover for tooltip</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Sheet
Renders as: `<dialog>` (SheetContent)
```tsx
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger>
    <Button>Open Sheet</Button>
  </SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent>
    <p>Sheet content</p>
    <SheetClose>
      <Button>Close</Button>
    </SheetClose>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
```

#### Drawer
Renders as: `<dialog>` (DrawerContent)
```tsx
<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger>
    <Button>Open Drawer</Button>
  </DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent>
    <p>Drawer content</p>
    <DrawerClose>
      <Button>Close</Button>
    </DrawerClose>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>
```

### Data Display Components

#### Table
Renders as: `<table>`
```tsx
<Table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Name</th>
      <th>Email</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td>John Doe</td>
      <td>john@example.com</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</Table>
```

#### Badge
Renders as: `<span>`
```tsx
<Badge>Default</Badge>
<Badge variant="secondary">Secondary</Badge>
<Badge variant="destructive">Destructive</Badge>
<Badge variant="outline">Outline</Badge>
```

#### Avatar
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<Avatar src="https://example.com/avatar.png" alt="Profile" />
<Avatar>JD</Avatar>  // Fallback initials
<Avatar size="sm|lg">SM</Avatar>  // Different sizes
```

#### Alert
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<Alert>
  <strong>Info:</strong> Informational message
</Alert>
<Alert variant="destructive">
  <strong>Error:</strong> Error message
</Alert>
```

#### Progress
Renders as: `<progress>`
```tsx
<Progress value={50} max={100} />
```

#### Skeleton
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<Skeleton style={{height: '1.5rem'}} />
<Skeleton style={{height: '1.5rem', width: '60%'}} />
```

### Interactive Components

#### Accordion
Renders as: `<details>`
```tsx
<Accordion name="accordion-group">  // Radio-style grouping
  <summary>More Info</summary>
  <p>Hidden content</p>
</Accordion>
<Accordion name="accordion-group">
  <summary>Another Item</summary>
  <p>More hidden content</p>
</Accordion>
```

#### Collapsible
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<Button onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Toggle</Button>
<Collapsible open={open}>
  <div>Collapsible content</div>
</Collapsible>
```

#### Toggle & ToggleGroup
Renders as: `<button>` (Toggle), `<div>` (ToggleGroup)
```tsx
<Toggle pressed={pressed} onClick={() => setPressed((v) => !v)}>Bold</Toggle>
<Toggle disabled>Disabled</Toggle>

<ToggleGroup type="multiple" value={values} onValueChange={setValues}>
  <Toggle value="bold">Bold</Toggle>
  <Toggle value="italic">Italic</Toggle>
  <Toggle value="underline">Underline</Toggle>
</ToggleGroup>
```

#### Carousel
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<Carousel id="unique-id">  // Optional ID
  <CarouselContent>
    <CarouselItem>Slide 1</CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem>Slide 2</CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem>Slide 3</CarouselItem>
  </CarouselContent>
  <CarouselPrevious>‹</CarouselPrevious>
  <CarouselNext>›</CarouselNext>
</Carousel>
```

#### Calendar
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<Calendar />
```

#### DatePicker
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<DatePicker />
```

#### Combobox
Renders as: Various elements
```tsx
<Combobox>
  <ComboboxInput />
  <ComboboxList>
    <ComboboxOption>Option 1</ComboboxOption>
    <ComboboxOption>Option 2</ComboboxOption>
  </ComboboxList>
</Combobox>
```

#### Resizable
Renders as: `<div>`
```tsx
<Resizable style={{width: '150px', height: '80px'}}>
  Resize me
</Resizable>
```

### Layout & Container Components

#### Sidebar
Renders as: `<dialog>` (Sidebar), `<button>` (SidebarTrigger)
```tsx
<Sidebar id="sidebar-id" style={{width: '16rem'}}>
  <h3>Navigation</h3>
  <nav>
    <a href="/dashboard" aria-current="page">Dashboard</a>
    <a href="/settings">Settings</a>
  </nav>
</Sidebar>

<SidebarTrigger commandFor="sidebar-id">
  ☰
</SidebarTrigger>
```

### Toast System

#### Toast API
```tsx
// Import toast and ToastContainer
import { toast, ToastContainer } from 'kinu';

// Basic toast
toast.show('Hello world!');

// Toast with options
toast.show('Event created successfully!', {
  title: 'Success',
  icon: '✓',
  action: <Button>Undo</Button>,
  duration: 5000  // Default: 3000ms
});

// Add container to your app
<ToastContainer />
```

Interface for toast options:
```tsx
interface ToastOptions {
  title?: ComponentChild;      // Optional title
  icon?: ComponentChild;       // Optional icon
  action?: ComponentChild;     // Optional action button
  duration?: number;          // Duration in milliseconds
}
```

## Styling System

### CSS Attribute Selectors
All components use a `k` attribute for CSS targeting:
```css
[k="button"] { /* Button styles */ }
[k="button"][variant="secondary"] { /* Secondary button */ }
[k="input"][disabled] { /* Disabled input */ }
```

### Variants & States
Most components support variants through attributes:
- `variant`: Style variants (e.g., "secondary", "destructive", "outline")
- `size`: Size variants (e.g., "sm", "md", "lg", "icon")
- `disabled`: Disabled state
- `aria-*`: Accessibility states (e.g., `aria-selected`, `aria-pressed`)

### Custom Styling
Components accept custom attributes and styles:
```tsx
<Button className="custom-class" data-testid="btn">Custom Button</Button>
<Card style={{backgroundColor: 'red'}}>Styled Card</Card>
```

## HTML Commands Integration

kinu leverages HTML's built-in [commands feature](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/command-and-commandfor) with a lightweight polyfill. Commands enable declarative interactions between elements using `command` and `commandfor` attributes:

```tsx
// Command triggers
<Button commandfor="dialog-id" command="show-modal">Open Dialog</Button>
<SidebarTrigger commandFor="sidebar-id">Toggle Sidebar</SidebarTrigger>

// Command targets  
<Dialog.Content id="dialog-id" command="close">Dialog content</Dialog.Content>
```

Standard HTML commands supported:
- `show`: Show element
- `show-modal`: Show as modal dialog  
- `close`: Close element
- Custom commands: `--prev`, `--next` (Carousel navigation)

## Accessibility Features

### Keyboard Navigation
- All interactive components support keyboard navigation
- Focus management for overlays and modals
- Escape key support for closing overlays

### ARIA Attributes
- Proper ARIA roles and states
- Screen reader friendly labels
- Semantic HTML structure

### Form Integration
```tsx
<form>
  <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
  <Input id="email" type="email" required />
  
  <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
  <Input id="password" type="password" required />
  
  <Button type="submit">Submit</Button>
</form>
```

## Usage Patterns

### Event Handling
```tsx
// Input events
<Input onInput={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} />

// Button clicks
<Button onClick={(e) => handleClick(e)}>Click me</Button>

// Form submission
<form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleSubmit(); }}>
```

### State Management
```tsx
const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
const [selectedTab, setSelectedTab] = useState('first');
const [formData, setFormData] = useState({});
```

### Compound Components
Many components use compound patterns for flexibility:
```tsx
// Dialog compound
<Dialog>
  <Dialog.Trigger>Trigger</Dialog.Trigger>
  <Dialog.Content>Content</Dialog.Content>
  <Dialog.Close>Close</Dialog.Close>
</Dialog>

// Navigation compound
<NavigationMenu>
  <NavigationMenuList>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuLink>Link</NavigationMenuLink>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
  </NavigationMenuList>
</NavigationMenu>
```

## Best Practices

- Always provide proper labels for form controls
- Use semantic HTML structure with proper ARIA attributes
- Handle loading and error states appropriately
- Use the toast system for user feedback
- Style with CSS attribute selectors: `[k="component-name"]`
- Leverage variant attributes and CSS custom properties for theming

## Integration Examples

### Form with Validation
```tsx
function MyForm() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    // Validation logic
    toast.show('Form submitted!', { title: 'Success', icon: '✓' });
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <Card>
        <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
        <Input 
          id="email"
          type="email" 
          value={email}
          onInput={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          required 
        />
        
        <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
        <Input 
          id="password"
          type="password" 
          value={password}
          onInput={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          required 
        />
        
        <Button type="submit">Sign In</Button>
      </Card>
    </form>
  );
}
```

### Dashboard Layout
```tsx
function Dashboard() {
  return (
    <div className="dashboard">
      <Sidebar id="main-sidebar">
        <nav>
          <a href="/dashboard" aria-current="page">Dashboard</a>
          <a href="/users">Users</a>
          <a href="/settings">Settings</a>
        </nav>
      </Sidebar>
      
      <main>
        <header>
          <SidebarTrigger commandFor="main-sidebar">☰</SidebarTrigger>
          <NavigationMenu>
            <NavigationMenuList>
              <NavigationMenuItem>
                <NavigationMenuLink href="/">Home</NavigationMenuLink>
              </NavigationMenuItem>
            </NavigationMenuList>
          </NavigationMenu>
        </header>
        
        <div className="content">
          <Card>
            <h1>Dashboard</h1>
            <Progress value={75} max={100} />
          </Card>
        </div>
      </main>
      
      <ToastContainer />
    </div>
  );
}
```

This documentation provides a comprehensive overview of the kinu component library, including all component interfaces, usage patterns, and best practices for building modern web applications with Preact.
